one_line: The Mughal emperor Jahangir and his master painter Ustad Mansur, portrayed amid their natural history observations at court.

appearance.age_look: Jahangir appears in his mid-30s to early 40s, slim but poised; Ustad Mansur appears in his late 30s, slightly narrower build and more reserved posture.
appearance.face: Jahangir has an oval face, light brown complexion, finely arched brows, sharp nose, neatly trimmed mustache and short pointed beard, with a calm yet keen default expression; Mansur has a slightly longer face, medium brown complexion, softer brows, short mustache and trace of a beard, with an intent, focused default expression.
appearance.hair: Both wear their hair tied back under Mughal-style turbans: Jahangir’s turban is a pale gold jama-bandh turban with a subtle striped wrap and a single jade-green feather plume pinned by a small ruby-and-gold jewel, while Mansur’s is a plain soft cream turban with a faint diagonal weave and no jewel.
appearance.costume: Jahangir wears a knee-length, finely patterned light saffron-gold jama (overlapping wrap coat) in light silk with delicate all-over floral sprigs in pale green and white, fastened at his right side with small cloth ties, over slim white churidar trousers and a narrow emerald green silk patka (waist sash) knotted at his left hip with its end hanging; he has a simple dark red leather belt over the patka, modest pearl-and-gem mala around his neck, a thin gold armlet visible on his right forearm, and soft brown leather mojari shoes with slightly upturned toes; Ustad Mansur wears a simpler light blue-grey cotton jama with very fine white vertical stripes, also knee-length and tied to the right, over off-white churidar trousers and a muted rust-brown cotton patka knotted in front, with a dark indigo cloth portfolio strap slung diagonally across his chest and plain brown mojari shoes.
appearance.signature: Jahangir’s signature prop is a slim, finely worked golden huqqa mouthpiece held lightly in his right hand, while Ustad Mansur’s is a flat, dark indigo leather folio held in his left arm with a visible corner of a detailed bird painting peeking out.

ref_desc: Jahangir is a slim Mughal emperor with light brown oval face, short pointed beard, pale gold turban with jade-green feather, saffron-gold floral silk jama, white churidar, emerald patka and brown mojari holding a golden huqqa mouthpiece beside Ustad Mansur, a focused medium-brown painter with cream turban, light blue-grey striped jama, rust-brown patka, brown mojari and a dark indigo folio showing a bird painting corner, all in saffron gold, emerald green, cream, light blue-grey and rust brown tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of two Mughal court figures standing side by side in a natural history setting: on the left Jahangir, slim and regal, light brown oval face with neatly trimmed mustache and short pointed beard, calm keen eyes and slightly lifted chin, wearing a pale gold Mughal turban with subtle stripes and a single jade-green feather plume pinned by a tiny ruby-and-gold jewel; his knee-length light saffron-gold silk jama is patterned with delicate pale green and white floral sprigs and overlaps to the right, tied with small cloth ties, worn over slim white churidar trousers and an emerald green silk patka knotted at his left hip with the end hanging; a simple dark red leather belt lies over the patka, a modest pearl-and-gem mala rests at his neck, a thin gold armlet circles his right forearm, and he wears soft brown leather mojari with slightly upturned toes; in his right hand he lightly holds a slim golden huqqa mouthpiece as his signature prop, his expression composed yet observant; on the right Ustad Mansur stands slightly behind and angled toward him, medium brown complexion, slightly longer face with short mustache and faint beard, eyes intent and focused, wearing a plain soft cream turban with faint diagonal weave, a knee-length light blue-grey cotton jama with very fine white vertical stripes tied to the right, off-white churidar trousers, and a muted rust-brown cotton patka knotted in front; a dark indigo leather folio hangs from a strap diagonally across his chest and he cradles the folio under his left arm, with one corner revealing a finely painted bird; he also wears plain brown mojari; keep proportions shonen-anime stylised but clothing, turbans, sashes, jewelry and shoes historically plausible, and use a harmonious palette dominated by saffron gold, emerald green, cream, light blue-grey and rust brown, with clear front and slight three-quarter poses to show all costume details and props.
